support_claim: The packet associates CRM NBA-102 with the short name "Northbridge Analytics" and billing with "Northbridge Analytics Inc.", while noting an additional Wyoming LLC candidate and stating that legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires evidence establishing legal identity and DISTINCT requires evidence establishing distinctness; the packet provides only compatible naming variants and an explicit instruction to treat the registry link as unresolved, which does not meet either burden.
